description: def build(name:, version: nil) -- an optional keyword, whose default is `nil`, whose body then *narrows* it. The rung where tier 12 and tier 14 meet: the parameter's type at a call site that omits it is `Nil`, at one that supplies it is `String`, and only per-call-site instantiation makes both precise. A checker with one signature per method would have to type it `nilable String` in both.
